en: A sepia-toned historic street scene printed within a beige card border with a thin red frame. The wide boulevard is lined with multistory 19th‑century European buildings on both sides, with awnings over shopfronts. Numerous pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and horse‑drawn carriages travel down the center of the street. The bottom margin of the card bears a caption in red Gothic-style lettering reading "Der Alexander-Boulevard."
